{
  "status": "ADVISORY",
  "observations": [
    "BrazilCo's BRL operating account is forecasted to fall below the required T+1 minimum by 80,000 BRL, resulting in a shortfall condition.",
    "Eligible same-entity funds are available in BrazilCo's BRL reserve account, which has a sufficient current balance to cover the projected gap while maintaining the post-transfer minimum required by policy.",
    "Both the operating and reserve accounts are approved and within the same legal entity, satisfying policy requirements for intragroup transfers.",
    "The authority envelope and treasury policy permit an intragroup transfer in BRL up to 1,000,000 BRL, with approval required for amounts above 100,000 BRL.",
    "No cross-entity or cross-currency transfers are necessary to address the immediate T+1 BRL liquidity gap.",
    "All relevant balances and forecasts are current and within the data age requirements specified by policy."
  ]
}
